claim.summary: A RawCoordinateDominanceCertificate can be consumed as a StrCC-style finite-coordinate continuation certificate. It certifies that a target coordinate shifted-dominates every coordinate in a finite competitor list under explicit raw residual, raw strict-gap, and scalar side-condition evidence.

bridge_interpretation: strict gap witness = cert.δ and cert.rawGap

proves: RawCoordinateDominanceCertificate can be consumed as a finite-coordinate continuation certificate
downstream bridge fixture can instantiate and use the core certificate object
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
